##### Project general facts

Woodland Residences is an exclusive gated villa community by AMIS Properties in collaboration with Lamborghini, offering a limited collection of just 30 ultra-luxury five-bedroom villas. Designed with an avant-garde architectural vision, each three-storey residence features expansive layouts, 13-foot ceilings, and generous living spaces starting from 7,300 sq. ft., creating an environment defined by space, comfort, and distinctive design.

The villas are thoughtfully equipped to deliver a seamless and elevated lifestyle, including rooftop pools, private lifts, and dedicated rooms for staff such as nanny, maid, and driver. The community enhances everyday living with a selection of amenities including children’s playgrounds, indoor play areas, relaxation zones, and a lagoon, providing a balanced setting for both leisure and family life within a secure and private environment.

Each residence showcases signature design elements with finishes inspired by Automobili Lamborghini, reflecting a bold and luxurious aesthetic. Kitchens are fitted with high-quality German appliances, while the villas are offered unfurnished, allowing homeowners to personalize their interiors while enjoying a home defined by innovation, exclusivity, and refined craftsmanship.

##### Location description and benefits

Meydan is an extraordinary community situated in the heart of Dubai, known for its blend of luxury, sophistication, and world-class amenities. Spanning over a vast area, Meydan offers a unique living experience that combines urban convenience with a tranquil and scenic environment.

One of the standout features of Meydan is its iconic Meydan Racecourse, which hosts renowned horse racing events, including the prestigious Dubai World Cup. The racecourse creates an aura of excitement and elegance, attracting enthusiasts from around the world. Residents of Meydan have the privilege of witnessing the thrilling races firsthand and immersing themselves in the vibrant atmosphere that surrounds this prestigious venue.

Green spaces are integral to the design of Meydan, with expansive parks, landscaped gardens, and tree-lined boulevards adorning the community. Residents can enjoy leisurely walks, bike rides, or picnics in these serene surroundings, offering a refreshing escape from the bustling city life. The abundance of open spaces also provides opportunities for outdoor activities and social gatherings, fostering a sense of community and well-being.
